title: Contribution
description: A typed value posted by a Knowledge Source onto a panel of the Blackboard. Multiple Contributions on the same (panel, subjectIdentityId, slot) coexist; Control resolves the effective value at read time using the configured ContributionResolver.

subjectIdentityId.description: Reference to the SubjectIdentity contribution this contribution is about. Null only on SourceInterpretation contributions (which precede subject identification).

slot.description: Panel-specific slot name (e.g. 'archetypeRefs', 'statement', 'verdict', 'evidenceItem', 'score'). See per-panel schemas.

value.description: Panel-specific value, validated against the panel schema for `slot`.

contributorKsId.description: Versioned gsmarc:// URI of the Knowledge Source that posted this contribution. May be 'gsmarc://gsm-sourcer/user/v1' for user-mediated overrides.

confidence.description: Self-declared confidence; used by the highestConfidence resolver. Optional. User-mediated contributions implicitly = 1.0.

cacheKey.description: MANDATORY when determinism = NON_DETERMINISTIC. Used by the InferenceService cache and by re-derivation replay.

derivedFrom.description: Engine-managed lineage: contribution ids and SourceInterpretation ids the contributor read.

supersedes.description: Optional: ids of prior Contributions on the same (panel, subjectIdentityId, slot) that this one explicitly supersedes (e.g. user override). Engine still keeps the superseded contributions for audit; resolver excludes them.
